import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] secondLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(secondLine[i]) % m;
        }

        Set<Integer> setA = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> setB = new HashSet<>();

        createSubsets(setA, a, 0, n / 2, 0, m);
        createSubsets(setB, a, n / 2, n, 0, m);

        List<Integer> sortedB = new ArrayList<>(setB);
        Collections.sort(sortedB);

        int maxValue = 0;
        for (int val : setA) {
            int pos = Collections.binarySearch(sortedB, m - val);
            if (pos < 0) {
                pos = -pos - 1;
            }
            if (pos > 0) {
                int sumCandidate = val + sortedB.get(pos - 1);
                if (sumCandidate > maxValue) {
                    maxValue = sumCandidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxValue);
    }

    private static void createSubsets(Set<Integer> subsetContainer, int[] a, int startIdx, int endIdx, int total, int m) {
        if (startIdx == endIdx) {
            subsetContainer.add(total);
        } else {
            createSubsets(subsetContainer, a, startIdx + 1, endIdx, (total + a[startIdx]) % m, m);
            createSubsets(subsetContainer, a, startIdx + 1, endIdx, total, m);
        }
    }
}
